function.name: run_swarm
function.description: Run the Swarm Desk persona swarm on one asset and return the aggregated verdict: mean stance, bullish/bearish split, a confidence in 0..1, and the H-QRD Agent 02 gate call (KEEP at confidence >= 0.70, otherwise PRUNE-CANDIDATE). The run is appended to the experiment ledger.

signals.description: Signal inputs, all optional. momentum/sentiment/value in -1..+1, volatility in 0..1.

function.name: check_gate
function.description: Map a Swarm Desk confidence (0..1) onto the H-QRD Agent 02 prune gate: KEEP when confidence >= 0.70, otherwise PRUNE-CANDIDATE.

function.name: list_personas
function.description: List the swarm's agent personas with their reasoning styles, signal weights, biases, noise scales and herd coefficients.

function.name: score_outcome
function.description: Attach a realized outcome to a past ledger entry so the prediction can be scored. Identify the entry by ledger_id, or by the (timestamp, asset) pair returned when it was run.

outcome.description: The realized outcome, e.g. the asset's return over the scoring window (0.05 = +5%), or a short label.
